story: Defuel ticket DF-SHL-BOS-26092411A (-2300 L) and a service invoice DFS-SHL-BOS-260924A: 2300 L x 0.032/L. Payload increase after fuelling put the aircraft over MTOW; supplier defuelled the excess.
Defuel ticket DF-WFS-HPN-26092411B (-2867 L) and a service invoice DFS-WFS-HPN-260924B: 2867 L x 0.032/L. Aircraft change after fuelling (tail swap); fuel taken off the original tail by the supplier.
Defuel ticket DF-WFS-BNA-26092511C (-3354 L) and a service invoice DFS-WFS-BNA-260925C: 3354 L x 0.032/L. Fuel quality hold - supplier defuelled for sampling, service charged.
Defuel ticket DF-CGA-SFO-26092512A (-2530 L) and credit note CN-CGA-SFO-260925A for -2530 L at the uplift price. Flight cancelled after fuelling; fuel returned to the supplier, credit note expected.
Defuel ticket DF-WFS-BDL-26092512B (-2153 L) and credit note CN-WFS-BDL-260925B for -2153 L at the uplift price. Over-fuelled by the supplier against the order; excess returned for credit.
Defuel ticket DF-SHL-BOS-26092412C (-2068 L) and credit note CN-SHL-BOS-260924C for -1768 L at the uplift price. Contamination suspected; fuel returned, part credited and part disposed (write-off).
Defuel ticket DF-SHL-BOS-26092613A (-2354 L) with disposition STORAGE to BOS-FS01; no invoice. Tankering plan cancelled; fuel moved to the airline storage tank at the station.
Defuel ticket DF-WFS-BOS-26092513B (-3389 L) with disposition STORAGE to BOS-FS01; no invoice. Defuel ahead of a heavy check; fuel held in the airline storage tank for re-use.
Defuel ticket DF-BPK-LHR-26092413C (-3828 L) with disposition STORAGE to LHR-FS01; no invoice. Fuel transferred off the tail into the airline storage tank pending re-uplift.
Defuel ticket DF-ATI-ORY-26102011A (-2233 L) and a service invoice DFS-ATI-ORY-261020A: 2233 L x 0.03/L. Payload increase after fuelling put the aircraft over MTOW; supplier defuelled the excess.
Defuel ticket DF-WFS-BOS-26102211B (-3147 L) and a service invoice DFS-WFS-BOS-261022B: 3147 L x 0.03/L. Aircraft change after fuelling (tail swap); fuel taken off the original tail by the supplier.
Defuel ticket DF-ATI-ZRH-26102211C (-2532 L) and a service invoice DFS-ATI-ZRH-261022C: 2532 L x 0.03/L. Fuel quality hold - supplier defuelled for sampling, service charged.
Defuel ticket DF-ATI-DSS-26102213A (-2292 L) with disposition STORAGE to DSS-FS01; no invoice. Tankering plan cancelled; fuel moved to the airline storage tank at the station.
Defuel ticket DF-GLP-LIS-26102213B (-1815 L) with disposition STORAGE to LIS-FS01; no invoice. Defuel ahead of a heavy check; fuel held in the airline storage tank for re-use.
Defuel ticket DF-WFS-EWR-26102113C (-2608 L) with disposition STORAGE to EWR-FS01; no invoice. Fuel transferred off the tail into the airline storage tank pending re-uplift.
